hypotheses:
plumb shows you very little: a one-line status that also shows progress while plumb works, at most one line in plumb's colour at the end of a turn, and questions. When something needs you it comes as a question through the question tool; the browser study room holds a study with its diagrams when there is more to study, never a question to answer; there are no cards to read and press. will: End a turn with at most one short plumb line, in plumb's colour, saying what changed for you, and nothing when nothing did.

will: Use the browser study room for a study that needs a diagram or more evidence; the question it informs is asked and answered through the question tool (INT-114).

will: Give the agent everything else as text, on every host.
won't: Cards you read and press, read-back cards, choice cards, and their Confirm, No and Undo buttons.
won't: A panel that walks intents and requirements for you to read (the Obsidian view on request stays).
won't: The full/compact/off card setting.
won't: Questions restated as prose lists, or lists of records at the end of a turn.
won't: Shipping the diagram mod or its skill inside plumb.
won't: A coding agent of the study room's own, for now.

Question: You said: "I dont think it should be showing anything apart maybe a small minimal status information that indicates a new card was pushed, or that a card was successfully resolved". Should plumb show a band above the prompt with the state, the counts and an animation while it works, or only a one-line status plus one short plumb line at the end of a turn?

You said: "I dont think it should be showing anything apart maybe a small minimal status information that indicates a new card was pushed, or that a card was successfully resolved or something like that, and it should be obvious that it is plumb talking."
Options: One-line status only (Recommended) (Plumb shows a single status line and one short plumb-coloured line at turn end. No band, counts or animation are added. Recommended: Your words ask for very little on screen, so the single status line matches them best.); Band with counts and animation (Plumb also shows a small band above the prompt with the state, the counts and an animation while it works.)
Answer: One-line status only (Recommended)

Question: When you asked for very little on screen, did you also mean that the agent should get everything as text on every host, and that the full, compact and off settings should go? Or should only what you see change?

You said on undated: "I dont think it should be showing anything apart maybe a small minimal status information that indicates a new card was pushed, or that a card was successfully resolved or something like that, and it should be obvious that it is plumb talking."
Options: Only what I see changes (Recommended) (The owner sees little on screen. How the agent is fed and the full, compact and off settings stay as they are today. Nothing about the agent side is changed. Recommended: Your words only ask for very little on your screen; they say nothing about what the agent receives.); Agent gets everything as text on every host; settings retired (The agent is fed all records as text on every host, and the full, compact and off settings are removed as well as the owner's screen being reduced.)
Answer: Only what I see changes (Recommended)
